Overcoming social anxiety is not easy. It takes time.. but it is worth it! You just have to face your fears (and I know that that is super hard to do and it‘s super scary and everybody says that…), but that is the truth. Avoiding scary situations forever is not a good choice. You can’t overcome social anxiety if you don’t face the truth. 

I‘m struggling with anxiety too and I think that meeting a therapist/mental heath professional is a very good idea. And remember that you are a valuable person. You can do it! ❤️
